versos.grego: φοβηθῶμεν οὖν μή ποτε καταλειπομένης ἐπαγγελίας εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ δοκῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ὑστερηκέναι.

controles.web: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
controles.kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
controles.livre: Temamos, pois, para que, havendo sido deixada a promessa de entrar no seu repouso, não pareça que algum de vós tenha ficado para trás.

versos.grego: καὶ γάρ ἐσμεν εὐηγγελισμένοι καθάπερ κἀκεῖνοι· ἀλλ’ οὐκ ὠφέλησεν ὁ λόγος τῆς ἀκοῆς ἐκείνους μὴ συνκεκερασμένος τῇ πίστει τοῖς ἀκούσασιν.

controles.web: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
controles.kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
controles.livre: Pois também a nós foi pregado o evangelho, assim como a eles; mas a palavra da pregação nada lhes aproveitou, porque não estava unida pela fé naqueles que a ouviram.

versos.grego: Εἰσερχόμεθα γὰρ εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν οἱ πιστεύσαντες, καθὼς εἴρηκεν Ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου, καίτοι τῶν ἔργων ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου γενηθέντων.

controles.web: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest”; although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
controles.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
controles.livre: Porque nós, os que cremos, entramos no repouso, como ele disse: Então jurei na minha ira: “Eles não entrarão no meu repouso”; ainda que as suas obras já estivessem terminadas desde a fundação do mundo.

versos.grego: εἴρηκεν γάρ που περὶ τῆς ἑβδόμης οὕτως Καὶ κατέπαυσεν ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works”;
controles.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
controles.livre: Pois, em certo lugar, ele disse assim a respeito do dia sétimo: E Deus repousou no sétimo dia de todas as suas obras.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ πάλιν Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.

controles.web: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
controles.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
controles.livre: E, outra vez neste texto : Não entrarão no meu repouso.

versos.grego: ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀπολείπεται τινὰς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτήν, καὶ οἱ πρότερον εὐαγγελισθέντες οὐκ εἰσῆλθον δι’ ἀπείθειαν,

controles.web: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,
controles.kjv: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
controles.livre: Portanto, uma vez que resta alguns entrarem no repouso,  e que aqueles a quem primeiramente foi pregado o evangelho não entraram por causa da desobediência,

versos.grego: πάλιν τινὰ ὁρίζει ἡμέραν, Σήμερον, ἐν Δαυεὶδ λέγων μετὰ τοσοῦτον χρόνον, καθὼς προείρηται Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

controles.web: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said),  “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
controles.kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
controles.livre: outra vez ele determina um certo dia, o “hoje”, dizendo por meio de Davi muito tempo depois (como já foi dito): Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς κατέπαυσεν, οὐκ ἂν περὶ ἄλλης ἐλάλει μετὰ ταῦτα ἡμέρας.

controles.web: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
controles.kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
controles.livre: Pois se Josué tivesse lhes dado repouso, ele não teria falado depois a respeito de outro dia.

versos.grego: ἄρα ἀπολείπεται σαββατισμὸς τῷ λαῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
controles.kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
controles.livre: Portanto, ainda resta um repouso como o do sábado para o povo de Deus.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ, ὥσπερ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰδίων ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
controles.kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
controles.livre: Pois aquele que entrou no seu repouso também repousou das suas obras, assim como Deus das suas.

versos.grego: Σπουδάσωμεν οὖν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν κατάπαυσιν, ἵνα μὴ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τις ὑποδείγματι πέσῃ τῆς ἀπειθείας.

controles.web: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
controles.kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
controles.livre: Procuremos, pois, entrar naquele repouso; para que ninguém caia no mesmo exemplo de desobediência.

versos.grego: Ζῶν γὰρ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐνεργὴς καὶ τομώτερος ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν μάχαιραν δίστομον καὶ διϊκνούμενος ἄχρι μερισμοῦ ψυχῆς καὶ πνεύματος, ἁρμῶν τε καὶ μυελῶν, καὶ κριτικὸς ἐνθυμήσεων καὶ ἐννοιῶν καρδίας·

controles.web: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
controles.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
controles.livre: Porque a palavra de Deus é viva e eficaz, e mais afiada do que toda espada de dois gumes, e que penetra até a divisão da alma e do espírito, das juntas e das medulas, e é apta para julgar os pensamentos e intenções do coração.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

controles.web: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
controles.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
controles.livre: E não há criatura alguma encoberta diante dele; ao contrário, todas as coisas estão nuas e expostas aos olhos daquele a quem temos de prestar contas.

versos.grego: Ἔχοντες οὖν ἀρχιερέα μέγαν διεληλυθότα τοὺς οὐρανούς, Ἰησοῦν τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ, κρατῶμεν τῆς ὁμολογίας.

controles.web: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.
controles.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
controles.livre: Já que temos um grande Sumo Sacerdote, Jesus, o Filho de Deus, que passou através dos céus, mantenhamos firme a nossa declaração de fé.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα μὴ δυνάμενον συνπαθῆσαι ταῖς ἀσθενείαις ἡμῶν, πεπειρασμένον δὲ κατὰ πάντα καθ’ ὁμοιότητα χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας.

controles.web: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
controles.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
controles.livre: Pois não temos um Sumo Sacerdote que não possa se compadecer das nossas fraquezas; mas sim, um que foi provado em tudo, conforme a nossa semelhança, mas sem pecado.

versos.grego: προσερχώμεθα οὖν μετὰ παρρησίας τῷ θρόνῳ τῆς χάριτος, ἵνα λάβωμεν ἔλεος καὶ χάριν εὕρωμεν εἰς εὔκαιρον βοήθειαν.

controles.web: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
controles.kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
controles.livre: Portanto, acheguemo-nos com confiança ao trono da graça, para que possamos receber misericórdia e encontrar graça para sermos socorridos  no tempo adequado.
